items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: We were Celestan after Robert Clark. I was with Robert Clark.

ctx.x: Well, first was Robert Clark and then you went on to who? We can get it straight now.
We were Celestan after Robert Clark. I was with Robert Clark. We were Celestan last.

And Celestan was the last band player? The last band. And then Handy and the WPA were in between. That's right. And Huntley-Guardette? Was with us? No, I mean you played some jobs with him too. Oh, I did play jobs with him. Yeah, but that was after Robert Clark. That's right.
